title: Make unlinkTrace able to remove an invalid or stale link
statement: Stop validating the target type when removing a link, so a wrong-target, dangling or superseded reference can be withdrawn through the typed path, and give `answeredBy` a removal route it has never had. Keep the unknown-field refusal, and keep the lock, fresh read inside it, and atomic write. Cover the wrong-target, dangling and superseded cases with tests, each asserting the lint finding it clears.
notes: ⚠️ THIS MUST LAND BEFORE THE GUARD IS DERIVED. Until it does, `reviseArtifact` is the only way to clear a bad link, and it works solely because the guard's list is incomplete — one defect is the escape hatch for the other. See the decision this task belongs to.
